envelope.description: Store: finish() retrying branch and retryNow

body.title: Store: finish() retrying branch and retryNow
body.summary: In chat-queue-store.ts give finish() the retrying branch for a failed outcome: when cause is spawn, rate-limit, overloaded, network or timeout, acted is false and the row's attempts are below MAX_INFRA_RETRIES, write state retrying, attempts+1, next_attempt_at = now + RETRY_DELAYS_MS[attempts] and keep the error; otherwise failed with the error; the lease row is deleted in the same transaction in every case. Add retryNow(seq) to ChatQueueStore: UPDATE a retrying row's next_attempt_at to now, attempts unchanged, returning whether it matched.
acceptanceChecks: an infrastructure failure before acting becomes retrying with attempts 1, nextAttemptAt now plus 10 s, the same seq and the error kept, and the lease is released
attempts 1 and 2 use 1 min and 5 min, and a failure at attempts 3 becomes failed with the error
acted true, cause auth, cause other or a missing cause becomes failed and is never retrying
retryNow makes a retrying row due at once with attempts unchanged and returns false for any other row
